2609.38659.title: Bandits with Multiple Optimal Arms: Minimax Regret and Non-Adaptivit
2609.38659.paper_summary: We study multi-armed bandits (MAB) with multiple optimal arms, motivated by the fact that many practical decision making problems admit multiple correct answers. For $K$-armed bandits with $A$ optimal arms, we first provide a sharper analysis of previous sub-sampling algorithms (De Heide et al., 2021; Zhu and Nowak, 2020), establishing a $\tilde{O}\Big(\frac{K-A}{\sqrt{KA}}\sqrt{T} \Big)$ minimax regret, where $T$ is the total number of interactions and $\tilde O(\cdot)$ drops all constant and logarithmic factors, improving the previous $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT/A})$ regret. We then provide a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors, indicating that our established rate is nearly minimax-optimal. We further show that the knowledge of $A$ up to $\tilde{O}(1)$ factors is necessary to achieve near-optimal regret, as near-optimal algorithms for one number of optimal arms must incur substantially larger regret than optimal regret for a smaller number. Overall, our results provide a comprehensive minimax characterization of $K$-armed bandits with $A$ over the entire range of $1 \leq A \leq K-1$.
2609.38659.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究具有多個最佳臂的多臂賭徒（MAB），這是因為許多實際的決策問題存在多個正確答案。對於具有 $A$ 個最佳臂的 $K$ 臂賭徒，我們首先提供了對先前子抽樣算法（De Heide et al., 2021; Zhu and Nowak, 2020）更精確的分析，建立了 $\tilde{O}\Big(\frac{K-A}{\sqrt{KA}}\sqrt{T} \Big)$ 的最小最大遺憾，其中 $T$ 是總互動次數，$\tilde O(\cdot)$ 刪除了所有常數和對數因子，改善了先前的 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT/A})$ 遺憾。然後，我們提供了一個與對數因子相匹配的下界，表明我們建立的速率幾乎是最小最大最佳的。我們進一步顯示，對 $A$ 的了解至多需要 $\tilde{O}(1)$ 因子，以實現接近最佳的遺憾，因為對於一個最佳臂的數量，接近最佳的算法必須承擔比較小數量的最佳遺憾大得多的遺憾。總體而言，我們的結果提供了對於 $1 \leq A \leq K-1$ 整個範圍的 $K$ 臂賭徒與 $A$ 的綜合最小最大特徵描述。
